notes.title: Developer Update: What's on Our Workbench?
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have two pieces of news to share.

The first news is shrouded in mystery. We are working on a big game that’s far more ambitious than anything we’ve done before. We'd love to share more details, but it’s still too early. What’s important is that if you’re reading this, you’ll likely enjoy it :)

The second news is more niche. Over the past few months, we’ve created a small experimental game about fashion that we really like. It was initially quite experimental and ended up being so specialized that it appeals mainly to fans of fashion and the beloved roguelike genre. If you find yourself in this unique intersection, you might enjoy "The Great Couturier." And if you do, please leave a review on its page – it will help other fans of this (nonexistent?) genre discover the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850970/The_Great_Couturier/

That’s all for now. Stay tuned!
